# EDS 223 HW 2 - Redlining and Environmental Injustice

Create a map of historical redlining neighborhoods, including:
neighborhoods colored by HOLC grade
an appropriate base map

Load packages and data
```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false
library(sf)
library(tmap)
library(tidyverse)
library(spData)
```


```{r}

ej_screen <- st_read('EDS223-HW2/data/ejscreen/EJSCREEN_2023_BG_StatePct_with_AS_CNMI_GU_VI.gdb')

redline <- st_read('EDS223-HW2/data/mapping-inequality/mapping-inequality-los-angeles.json')

crashes <- st_read('EDS223-HW2/data/SWITRS_LA/Crashes.csv')
```


LA county
```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# filter to a state you are interested in
california <- ej_screen %>%
  dplyr::filter(ST_ABBREV == "CA") 

# find the average values for all variables within counties
ca_counties <- aggregate(california,
                              by = list(california$CNTY_NAME),
                              FUN = mean, na.rm = TRUE)


# filter to a county you are interested in
la <- ca_counties %>%
  dplyr::filter(Group.1 %in% c("Los Angeles County"))
```

crashes needs cleaning! make lat and long numeric

```{r}
crashes_clean <- crashes |> 
    mutate(POINT_X = as.numeric(POINT_X),
           POINT_Y = as.numeric(POINT_Y)) |> 
    filter(!is.na(POINT_X), !is.na(POINT_Y))
```


make the csv into a spatial object so we can assign the crs
```{r}
crashes_sf <- st_as_sf(crashes_clean,
                  coords = c("POINT_X", "POINT_Y"),  # x first, then y
                  crs = 4326)                 # WGS84

st_crs(crashes_sf)  # now check it
```

check other crs

```{r}
st_crs(la)
st_crs(redline)
```


```{r}
# make la fit with the other crs
la <- st_transform(la, 4326)
```

try mapping

```{r}
tm_shape(la, bbox = redline) + 
    tm_polygons() +
tm_shape(redline) +
    tm_polygons(fill = 'grade', lwd = 0.1)

```
